Agent.text:
I built a complete Bingo game that you can play right away. It has number bingo (on 3×3, 4×4 or 5×5 cards) and event-card bingo, where you build your own card from lists like "Party night" or "Movie night", or from items you type in. It also has automatic or manual calling, tap-to-daub, computer "buddies" who race you to BINGO, and Big Screen Mode for a TV. I tested full rounds in a real browser and found no errors, and the automated rule checks all pass.

The start page, the sound, language and menu pop-ups, and the five languages follow the original closely. The start page scores 85% alike and the pop-ups 80–85%, so it's close but short of the 90% target. The other pages (games list, privacy, terms, imprint) only score 41–65%. That's mainly because I used my own placeholder names ("Bingo Friends", "PlayPals"), my own mascot drawing and my own legal text instead of copying the original's brand, art and long texts. Overall the site comes out 58% alike, so it doesn't pass the 90% check.

Two things are different or unknown. First, the original lets friends join from their own phones, which needs a game server. Since you asked me to decide, I chose play on one device against computer buddies. Second, the original's lobby and in-game screens were never photographed, so I designed them in its style. Its imprint page also never finished loading when it was recorded, so I built that page in the same style as the privacy and terms pages.

A good next question: if you own the original or have permission to use its name, artwork and texts, tell me and I can swap them in to bring the pages much closer. Or you could ask me to add a real game server so friends can join a room from their own phones.
